description: This file defines the StatusCommand struct, which is a command-line command implementation for showing the daemon status, including configuration, wake word status, and recent transcripts.

classes.name: StatusCommand
classes.description: A command-line interface command that displays the daemon status, including configuration, wake word status, and recent transcript entries.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously loads configuration, retrieves the latest transcripts, and prints the current wake status and recent transcript entries.
